Name: Deluxe Preservation
Author: shadeinthestars
Description:
Adds 4 new craftables to the game: Hardwood Keg and Hardwood Preserves Jar that work twice as fast as normal kegs/jars, and Radioactive Keg and Radioactive Preserves Jar that work four times as fast.

You can get the Hardwood Keg/Preserves Jar crafting recipes from Robin once the Community Centre (or Joja Warehouse) is completed, and the Radioactive Keg and Preserves Jar from the same place you learn the Heavy Tapper recipe.

Works really well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8413]Advanced Casks[/url] and has built-in compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11752]Floral Liqueurs[/url]
